title: 10 Best Law Firm Websites 2026 | Contra Agency

facts.fact: The article is bylined to Callum Hornigold, Head of Marketing Services, and dated 31 October 2026.
facts.quote: **Callum Hornigold, Head of Marketing Services** 31 October 2026

facts.fact: Contra Agency states that the Hudgell Solicitors website doubled conversions year-on-year; this is the vendor's own claim.
facts.quote: doubled conversions year-on-year, making it a deserving contender.

facts.fact: Hudgell Solicitors has offices in three locations: Hull, Manchester and London.
facts.quote: Hudgell Solicitors is a leading law firm with offices in Hull, Manchester and London

facts.fact: Contra Agency's own claim is that its agency won three trophies at the Digital Impact Awards 2024.
facts.quote: Contra Agency claims three trophies at the Digital Impact Awards 2024.

facts.fact: The Hudgell Solicitors website won a Digital Impact Award for ‘Best Use of Digital in Professional Services’, according to the article.
facts.quote: helped the website win a Digital Impact Award for ‘Best Use of Digital in Professional Services’

facts.fact: Hugh James has offices in five locations: Cardiff, London, Manchester, Southampton and Plymouth.
facts.quote: Hugh James, a Welsh law firm with offices in Cardiff, London, Manchester, Southampton and Plymouth.
